summary: A young man sits in the seating area of an indoor climbing gym and takes a sip from a Celsius energy drink can before reaching to adjust the camera.

people.description: Young East Asian man with wavy dark hair, wearing a light blue short-sleeve button-down shirt, silver necklace, and earrings. Other gym patrons sit on benches in the blurred background.

quality.issues: Can occludes lens between 1.5s and 2.2s; hand reaching for camera at end

moments.action: Creator raises a Celsius energy drink can to his lips and takes a long drink while looking forward and slightly to the side
Creator lowers the can, swallows, and glances around the gym lounge before leaning forward
